disclosure_review.sampling_method: live interviews of likely general election voters
disclosure_review.sampling_frame: Massachusetts statewide likely voters; geographic and demographic quotas based on similar midterm exit polls and 2024 Census data
disclosure_review.weighting: quota variables disclosed: party, gender, race, age and four regions; exact weights not published in the inspected two PDFs
disclosure_review.question: At this point if the election were today, for whom would you vote or toward whom do you lean?
disclosure_review.question_sequence: Full three-candidate governor question after four-candidate U.S. Senate question Q7; vote/lean asked together, not a separately reported forced-choice follow-up.

reported_precision.scope: Massachusetts statewide LV500; separate Quincy300 excluded

value.limitations_ko: Suffolk/Boston Globe 단일 발표 Q8의 3후보 vote/lean 문항. 주 전체 LV500만 사용하며 Quincy300·상원 Q7·초기표/후속 강제양자를 합산하지 않음. 원문 58.6/36/2와 종료10/18을 사용하고 API 원본59/36/2·종료10/17은 보존. 후보명 오타는 정확한 이름 대조로만 연결. 기관 정확도 등급·당선확률·모든 미래 발표 승인이 아님.
